disagreementFindings.finding: Current “Download KiB/s” translations often read as an action and omit the field’s speed-limit meaning.
“Download Slots” was rendered as slot machines or as an action in multiple locales despite a global numeric slots field.
Several “Download approval” targets read as an instruction to download an approval rather than approval for downloads.
Current cancelled-retention labels read as download commands rather than retention duration fields.
Current errored-retention labels read as download commands rather than retention duration fields.
The caller is a downloads leaderboard status label; many current targets read as an instruction to download the leaderboard.
Hindi “unavailable” does not precisely match the caller branch for a missing/unconfigured download path.
